name: Engraved bar necklace
blurb: A slim bar on a fine chain that carries a name, a date or a place.
personalize: Keep it to about 12 characters. A nickname, a date in Roman numerals, or coordinates on the back all read well.

name: Initial pendant
blurb: One letter on a small disc or charm, worn every day.
personalize: Use their first initial, or their child's. Add another charm for each new arrival.

name: Script name necklace
blurb: Their name written in wire or cut from metal as the pendant itself.
personalize: Check the spelling they actually use, accents included. Names of three to eight letters sit best.

name: Family birthstone ring
blurb: A band or stack set with one stone for each person in the family.
personalize: Order the stones by birth order, and write which is whose on the card.

name: Coordinates cuff
blurb: A bracelet stamped with the latitude and longitude of a place that matters.
personalize: Where you met, the hospital, the first home. Put the place name inside so it stays a secret.

name: Handwriting pendant
blurb: A loved one's own handwriting, copied from a card or note onto a pendant.
personalize: Photograph a signature or a "love you" from an old card, flat on a table in good light.

name: Engraved signet ring
blurb: A flat-faced ring cut with initials or a small crest of your own design.
personalize: One to three letters. Ask whether the engraving reads for the wearer or is mirrored for sealing.

name: Watch with an engraved back
blurb: A message hidden where only the wearer sees it.
personalize: Three short lines at most: a date, four or five words, then your initial.

name: Engraved cufflinks
blurb: A pair that can carry two halves of one message.
personalize: Split it: initials on one, the date on the other. Or his initials on one and yours on the other.

name: Wallet with stamped initials
blurb: Leather pressed with two or three letters in a corner.
personalize: Blind stamping, with no foil, ages best. Add a short note on the inside flap if the maker offers it.

name: Engraved key ring
blurb: A small metal tag for a first car, a first home or a long drive home.
personalize: "Drive safe" plus an initial, the date they got the keys, or the coordinates of the house.

name: Photo locket
blurb: A locket that opens on one or two tiny photographs.
personalize: Choose close-up faces, because detail vanishes at this size. Engrave the back with a single word.

name: Birth flower pendant
blurb: The flower of their birth month drawn or pressed into a pendant.
personalize: Look up the month in the birth flower finder, then add an initial on the reverse.

name: Engraved pocket knife
blurb: A folding knife or multi-tool with a name on the handle.
personalize: Under 20 characters on most handles. A name and a year is plenty.

name: Engraved flask
blurb: A steel flask for the wedding party or a walking friend.
personalize: Role and date for the wedding party, or a private joke of three words.

name: Passport cover and luggage tag
blurb: A matching leather set stamped with initials.
personalize: Initials outside, and a line such as "Go far, come back" stamped inside the cover.

name: Engraved pen
blurb: A good pen with a name down the barrel.
personalize: About 30 characters. A full name for work, a first name and a date for a milestone.

name: Monogrammed tote bag
blurb: A canvas tote stitched with one bold initial or three small ones.
personalize: One large initial is the most useful. Three letters follow the first, LAST, middle order.

name: Monogrammed wash bag
blurb: A toiletry bag that makes even a work trip feel considered.
personalize: Initials in a contrasting thread, placed bottom right instead of dead centre.

name: Embroidered robe
blurb: A robe with a name or initials over the pocket.
personalize: A first name in script for one person. Matching pairs suit a wedding.

name: Monogrammed towel set
blurb: Bath towels with a stitched monogram for a new home.
personalize: Use the shared surname initial for household linen. Match the thread to the bathroom, not the towel.

name: Embroidered baby blanket
blurb: A soft blanket with the baby's name and birth date in a corner.
personalize: Wait until the name is registered. Name on one line, date beneath in smaller letters.

name: Name stocking
blurb: A Christmas stocking with a name stitched across the cuff.
personalize: Order one spare in the same thread for the next baby, partner or pet.

name: Embroidered handkerchief
blurb: A cotton handkerchief with a message for the wedding morning.
personalize: A line for a parent, such as "For your happy tears", with the date in a corner.

name: Embroidered cap
blurb: A cap with a nickname, a team or a tiny motif.
personalize: Keep to ten letters across the front. Small text on the side reads as a private joke.

name: Embroidered sweatshirt
blurb: A sweatshirt with a name on the chest or a date in Roman numerals on the cuff.
personalize: A child's name on the chest, or your anniversary on the sleeve where only you look.

name: Pet bandana
blurb: A bandana with the dog's or cat's name stitched on.
personalize: Name only, in capitals. Measure the neck before you order.

name: Embroidered apron
blurb: A sturdy apron with a title only they could hold.
personalize: "Head of pancakes", or simply their name. Thread in a colour from their kitchen.

name: Monogrammed pyjamas
blurb: Classic piped pyjamas with initials on the pocket.
personalize: Two or three initials in the piping colour. Size up; nobody minds loose pyjamas.

name: Engraved cutting board
blurb: A wooden board cut with a family name and the year the kitchen became theirs.
personalize: Surname, "est." and a year. Keep one side plain for chopping.

name: Handwritten recipe board
blurb: A relative's recipe card, in their own handwriting, etched into wood.
personalize: Scan the card at high resolution and leave the stains in. They are part of it.

name: Name or photo mug
blurb: The everyday gift, made theirs with a name, a face or a line they always say.
personalize: Print the design on both sides so it works left-handed. Their own catchphrase beats a slogan.

name: Engraved glasses
blurb: A pair of tumblers or wine glasses etched with initials or a date.
personalize: One initial each, or the wedding date on both. Etching outlasts print in a dishwasher.

name: Insulated tumbler with a name
blurb: A lidded cup for the commute, the classroom or the touchline.
personalize: A first name in one clean font. For a team: same cup, different names.

name: Family name doormat
blurb: A coir mat that tells visitors whose house this is.
personalize: Surname only, or "The Rossis". Check the plural: no apostrophe.

name: House name or number sign
blurb: A slate, wood or metal sign cut with a number, a name or both.
personalize: Match the numerals to the house: serif for old brick, plain for a new build.

name: Return address stamp
blurb: A self-inking stamp or embosser with their new address.
personalize: Triple-check the postcode with them. Initials in the centre make it a monogram too.

name: Candle with a custom label
blurb: A scented candle whose label names the person, the place or the day.
personalize: Name the scent after them: "Sunday at Nana's". Date on the base.

name: Woven name blanket
blurb: A throw with names or a family motto woven into the pattern.
personalize: List every family member, pets included, and leave space to add more.

name: Photo blanket
blurb: A fleece or woven throw printed with a collage of photographs.
personalize: Nine to sixteen photos is the limit before faces get too small.

name: Embroidered cushion
blurb: A cushion stitched with a date, a place or a short line.
personalize: Coordinates and a date, in one colour. It should read as decor first and message second.

name: Named ornament
blurb: A tree ornament marked with a name and the year.
personalize: One for each child each year becomes a set they take when they leave home.

name: Family established sign
blurb: A wooden or metal wall sign with the surname and the year the family began.
personalize: Use the wedding year or the year of the first home, whichever they tell stories about.

name: Custom coasters
blurb: A set of coasters printed with maps, photos or a monogram.
personalize: Four different places you have lived, one per coaster.

name: Engraved serving board
blurb: A slate or wood board for people who host.
personalize: Their surname and "est." year along one short edge, away from the food.

name: Engraved grill tools
blurb: Tongs and a spatula with a name burned into the handles.
personalize: Skip the stock titles. Use what the family actually calls him.

name: Painted name planter
blurb: A ceramic pot lettered with a name or a plant's nickname.
personalize: Name the plant, not the person. "Gerald the fern" gets a laugh every day.

name: Engraved garden marker
blurb: A metal or slate marker for a tree, a rose or a vegetable row.
personalize: For a memorial tree: the name, two dates, and four or five words.

name: Memorial wind chime
blurb: A chime with an engraved sail that moves when the wind does.
personalize: Name and dates on one side, a short line on the other.

name: Engraved keepsake box
blurb: A wooden box for letters, hospital bands, first shoes or medals.
personalize: Name and date on the lid. Put a longer note on a card inside, not on the wood.

name: Engraved photo frame
blurb: A frame with a small plate or border carrying names and a date.
personalize: Two lines of about 25 characters. Put the photo in before you wrap it.

name: Framed vows print
blurb: The words you said to each other, set in type and framed.
personalize: Send the exact text. Decide whether line breaks follow the sentences or the breath.

name: Night sky print
blurb: A chart of the stars as they stood over one place on one night.
personalize: You need the date, the town and the rough time. Add one line under the chart.

name: Custom map print
blurb: A street map centred on a place only the two of you would recognise.
personalize: Mark the spot with a small heart or pin, and caption it with the date, not the address.

name: Voice print
blurb: The wave shape of a spoken message, printed as artwork.
personalize: Record a child saying goodnight or a line from your vows. Add a small caption with the date.

name: Illustrated family portrait
blurb: An artist draws the household from your photographs, pets included.
personalize: Send one clear photo per person and say what each should be wearing or holding.

name: Pet portrait
blurb: A painted or illustrated portrait of their animal, with its name beneath.
personalize: Use a photo taken at the pet's eye level in daylight. Add the name in small capitals.

name: House portrait
blurb: A drawing of a first home, a family home or the one they are leaving.
personalize: Photograph the front straight on. Caption with the address and the years they lived there.

name: Birth details print
blurb: A print recording the name, date, time, weight and length of a new arrival.
personalize: Get the numbers from the parents, not from memory. Add the place of birth.

name: Name meaning print
blurb: The origin and meaning of a name, set out like a dictionary entry.
personalize: Check the meaning against two sources, because baby-name lists disagree.

name: Photo book of a year
blurb: A printed book that turns a phone's camera roll into something to hold.
personalize: One page per month keeps it finishable. Write captions the way you talk.

name: Photo calendar
blurb: Twelve months of family photographs with the birthdays already marked.
personalize: Put each person's photo on their birthday month and print the dates in the grid.

name: Photo on canvas
blurb: One photograph enlarged and stretched over a frame.
personalize: Check the pixel size before you order. The photo size calculator shows how large it can go.

name: Photo jigsaw
blurb: A jigsaw cut from a photograph: a present and an afternoon.
personalize: Busy photos make better puzzles than blue skies. Hide a message on the back if the maker allows.

name: Photo phone case
blurb: A case printed with a photo, a pattern or their initials.
personalize: Confirm the exact phone model first. Leave space around faces for the camera cut-out.

name: Photo magnets
blurb: A set of small square magnets for the fridge or the office.
personalize: Nine photos from one trip or one year. Grandparents keep them up for a decade.

name: Photo playing cards
blurb: A deck with their face, their dog or the family on the back.
personalize: One strong image for the back. Square photos crop badly on a tall card.

name: Storybook starring the child
blurb: A printed picture book in which the child is the hero by name.
personalize: Check the spelling, then check the character's hair and skin options. Add a dedication.

name: Wooden name puzzle
blurb: Chunky letters that spell the child's name and lift out of a board.
personalize: Engrave the birth details on the back. Longer names cost more, so ask before using the full one.

name: Named step stool
blurb: A small wooden stool with the child's name painted on the top.
personalize: Lowercase letters are easier for a child learning to read their own name.

name: Growth chart
blurb: A ruler for the wall with the child's name, ready for pencil marks.
personalize: Choose canvas or wood that rolls or unscrews, so it moves house with them.

name: Embroidered backpack
blurb: A school bag with a first name or initials on the pocket.
personalize: Initials, not the full name, on anything worn outside, so strangers cannot read it.

name: Name labels
blurb: Stick-on and iron-on labels for uniforms, bottles and lunch boxes.
personalize: First name and surname initial. Add a phone number for younger children.

name: Named money box
blurb: A ceramic or wooden bank for a first coin.
personalize: Name on the front; "started" and the date on the base.

name: Soft toy with stitched details
blurb: A bear or rabbit with the baby's name and birth details on a foot or ear.
personalize: Name on one foot, date on the other. Keep embroidery away from where a baby chews.

name: Baby milestone cards
blurb: A set of cards to photograph beside the baby each month.
personalize: Printable sets work today. Write the baby's name on the first card yourself.

name: Engraved children's cutlery
blurb: A small knife, fork and spoon with a name on each handle.
personalize: A classic naming present. Name only; the date goes on the box.

name: Name night light
blurb: A lamp cut or printed with the child's name that glows at bedtime.
personalize: Choose warm white over colour-changing if it is meant for sleep.

name: Notebook with a foil name
blurb: A hardback notebook stamped with a name or initials.
personalize: A full name for a student, initials for a professional. Gold foil on a dark cover.

name: Personal stationery set
blurb: Note cards and envelopes printed with their name.
personalize: Name only at the top, no address, so it survives a house move.

name: Desk name plate
blurb: A wood, brass or acrylic bar with a name and a title.
personalize: For a promotion: the new title. For fun: the title they deserve.

name: Engraved card case
blurb: A slim metal or leather case for business cards.
personalize: Initials in a corner; the start date of the new job inside the lid.

name: Leather desk mat with initials
blurb: A mat that makes a desk look deliberate.
personalize: Stamp initials bottom right, small. The size makes it personal, not the lettering.

name: Engraved award or plaque
blurb: A glass, wood or metal award with a name and the reason.
personalize: Say exactly what it is for, with the date. "For 22 years of Thursday rehearsals" beats "With thanks".

name: Engraved desk clock
blurb: A small clock with a plate, for a retirement or long service.
personalize: Name, years of service, and one line the team would recognise.

name: Golf balls and marker with initials
blurb: A sleeve of balls and a marker printed with initials or a joke.
personalize: Initials on the balls, the joke on the marker. He will lose the balls.

name: Engraved bottle opener
blurb: A solid opener that lives in the same drawer for twenty years.
personalize: A surname and "bar" works, or the coordinates of his favourite pub.

name: Embroidered sports bag
blurb: A holdall with a name, a number or a crest of your own design.
personalize: Surname and squad number, placed on the end panel.

name: Engraved guitar picks
blurb: A tin of picks stamped with a name, a date or words of their own.
personalize: Use their own words or band name, never a published lyric. Five or six characters per pick.

name: Library embosser or stamp
blurb: A stamp that marks each book "From the library of" and their name.
personalize: The full name, spelled the way it appears on their bookshelf.

name: Engraved bookmark
blurb: A leather or metal bookmark with a name or a line.
personalize: Their name and the year, or a line of your own about the first book you read together.

name: Named pencils
blurb: A box of pencils foil-stamped with a name or a classroom motto.
personalize: "Property of Ms Okafor" stops them walking. Twelve characters fits most pencils.

name: Teacher's marking stamp
blurb: A stamp with the teacher's name and a phrase they say every day.
personalize: Ask the class what the catchphrase is. They will know.

name: Engraved pet tag
blurb: A collar tag with the pet's name and your phone number.
personalize: Name on the front, two phone numbers on the back. Skip the address.

name: Named pet bowl
blurb: A ceramic bowl lettered with the pet's name.
personalize: Lowercase, in one colour. A heavier bowl stays put under an eager dog.

name: Pet memorial frame
blurb: A frame for a photograph and a collar tag, with the name and years.
personalize: Name, years, and a line about what they did best.

name: Iced biscuits with names
blurb: A tin of biscuits hand-iced with names, dates or a short message.
personalize: One biscuit per guest doubles as a place card. Order close to the day, because they are fresh.

name: Chocolate bar in your own wrapper
blurb: A favourite bar slipped into a wrapper you designed and printed.
personalize: Print the wrapper today: name on the front, the reason on the back.

name: Bottle with a custom label
blurb: A bottle of something they like, relabelled for the occasion.
personalize: Name the vintage after the year you met. Leave the original label underneath.

name: Printed gift tags
blurb: Tags with their name already printed, for presents all year.
personalize: Make a sheet in the gift tag maker and print it on card today.

name: Experience certificate
blurb: A promise of time together, printed to look as real as it is.
personalize: Be specific: "One Saturday, your choice of museum, I carry the bags." Add an expiry so it happens.

name: Coupon book
blurb: A small book of favours they can cash in.
personalize: Six coupons is enough. One should be absurd.

name: Framed name poem
blurb: An acrostic that spells their name, one line per letter.
personalize: Draft it in the name poem tool, then change two lines to things only you know.

name: Monogram print
blurb: Their monogram, framed, for a hallway or a nursery.
personalize: Build it in the monogram maker, download the picture and print it at home or at a print shop.

name: Jar of reasons
blurb: A jar filled with folded notes, each one a reason or a memory.
personalize: Write fifty-two, one for each week. Put their name on a tag round the neck.

name: Family recipe cards
blurb: A set of cards printed with the family's recipes and who they came from.
personalize: Credit each one: "Aunt Meera's dal, as taught to Raj in 1998".

name: Name-painted lamp set
blurb: Clay or brass lamps painted with a family name or initials.
personalize: The family name on the tray, an initial on each lamp.

name: Sweet box with a name sleeve
blurb: A box of sweets wrapped in a printed sleeve with the family's greeting.
personalize: Print the sleeve yourself: your family name, the year, and who it is for.

name: Named gift envelopes
blurb: Envelopes for gift money, printed with each child's name.
personalize: One envelope per child with the name in large letters. Print a spare.

name: Carved name seal
blurb: A stone or wooden seal cut with a name, used with red ink.
personalize: Confirm the characters with a native reader before carving. A case and ink pad complete it.

name: Engraved festival keepsake
blurb: A candle holder or spinning top for the festival table, marked with a name and year.
personalize: A child's name and the year of their first festival.

name: Custom cake topper
blurb: Names or a date cut from wood or acrylic to stand on the cake.
personalize: First names only, joined by an ampersand. Ask the baker for the cake's width first.

name: Painted ring dish
blurb: A small ceramic dish for rings, lettered with initials and a date.
personalize: Both initials and the wedding date. It lives by the sink for decades.

name: Engraved compass
blurb: A brass compass with a message inside the lid.
personalize: A line about finding the way home. Keep it under 60 characters over three lines.

name: Frame with a graduation plate
blurb: A frame for the certificate with a plate naming the award and year.
personalize: Name, award and year, exactly as written on the certificate.

name: Signed memory book
blurb: A bound book in which everyone writes a page before the last day.
personalize: Emboss the cover with their name and years. Start collecting pages three weeks early.

name: Fingerprint keepsake
blurb: A charm or key ring carrying a loved one's fingerprint.
personalize: Makers send an ink or wax kit. Engrave the name on the reverse.

name: Bench or tree plaque
blurb: A small plaque for a favourite seat, a planted tree or a garden wall.
personalize: Name, dates, and where they loved to sit. Ask who owns the bench before you fix anything to it.

name: Engraved enamel mug
blurb: A tin mug for people who drink tea outdoors.
personalize: Their trail name, or the summit and the date.

name: Engraved hand tool
blurb: A hammer, trowel or tape measure with a name on the handle.
personalize: "Dad's. Put it back." is the correct engraving.
